{"consolidated_memory":"## 401 Storm in services/auth/token_refresh.py — Six Separate Incidents

All incidents occurred in the same file (`services/auth/token_refresh.py`) on the authentication side. Common pattern: burst of unauthorized responses in the access log; repro: let access token expire mid-session.

### Incident 1: [2026-02-19] — Accounts in five-percent rollout bucket
- **Root cause**: Cache entry never invalidated on write
- **Fix**: Invalidated entry inside write transaction (PR #3576, branch fix/401-storm-1)
- **Result**: 32 duplicate rows a day stopped being written

### Incident 2: [2026-02-25] — Records carrying non-ASCII names
- **Root cause**: Naive datetime compared against aware one
- **Fix**: Made every boundary timezone aware at the edge (PR #5292, branch fix/401-storm-2)
- **Result**: Alert stayed quiet for 96 consecutive days

### Incident 3: [2026-03-06] — Tenants with more than ten thousand distinct keys
- **Root cause**: Missing Unicode normalisation before hashing
- **Fix**: Normalised to NFC ahead of the digest (PR #6809, branch fix/401-storm-3)
- **Result**: Memory settled at 129 MB instead of climbing past 5 GB

### Incident 4: [2026-06-04] — Clients still pinned to the v1 SDK
- **Root cause**: Listener registered but never removed
- **Fix**: Removed listener on teardown and asserted it in a test (PR #7424, branch fix/401-storm-4)
- **Result**: Throughput rose 23 percent, to 737 requests per second

### Incident 5: [2026-07-11] — Sessions arrived through OAuth provider
- **Root cause**: Clock skew between two hosts
- **Fix**: Switched deadline to monotonic clock (PR #7626, branch fix/401-storm-5)
- **Result**: Nightly rollup matched source counts for 18 days running

### Incident 6: [2026-07-31] — After rolling restart of the fleet
- **Root cause**: Unbounded retry loop with no backoff
- **Fix**: Capped attempts and added exponential backoff with jitter (PR #8716, branch fix/401-storm-6)
- **Result**: Job finished in 16 minutes instead of 3 hours"}
